practicalAssessorReference: Start-up: neutral selected, park brake engaged; horn ONCE then a 5–10 second delay before starting; check warning lights out; do not idle more than 20 minutes (Manual §6).
Interlocks: steering lock locks steering and F/R gears; implement lock hydraulically locks the implement; transmission lock holds neutral (Manual §6.1).
Leaving the cab: flat level ground, ground the bucket, shut down, apply all safety locks and the park brake; never use the steering wheel or levers as a hand-hold (Manual §6.2).
Moving off: clear the 40 m exclusion zone, seat belt fitted, horn TWICE then 5–10 seconds, bucket ~300–400 mm off the ground for travel (Manual §8).
Operational safety checks before leaving the park-up: primary AND secondary steering, brake pedal holding/accumulator, bucket and boom kick-outs — only proceed if all work (Manual §8.1).
Travel: bucket level at 300–400 mm, not curled to carry unless carrying material; downhill in 1st gear using engine braking, brake pedal to assist, never the impeller pedal (Manual §9, §9.1).
Lost or damaged G.E.T is a Category A fault — report immediately, replace before operating; unrecovered G.E.T area demarcated by GPS/survey (Manual §10.1).
Misfire found: stop, notify the Supervisor, barricade and keep 10 m clear (Manual §11.1).

Hopper clean-up sequence: Duty Production Supervisor permission → control room orange lights → inform truck operators → enter; afterwards restore green lights via control room and inform the Supervisor/pit control (Manual §16).
Incident: stop work, call the Supervisor, gather evidence; bogged/stuck — do not self-recover, JHA before removal (Manual §17).
